hero.subtitle: Ready property in Dubai means passive income that starts within 14 days after the deal. The property manager handles tenants, repairs and taxes. You receive clean cashflow in dollars.

items.d: The property is built and often already tenanted. After closing, the property manager signs a contract within 7–14 days. Cashflow begins before month-end.
We handle tenant search, vetting, contracts, DEWA bills, cleaning and minor repairs. You receive a clean transfer once a month. Fee 8–12%.
The property exists. You can visit it, walk through, inspect the finish. No delays, no force majeure. Utilities, lifts, infrastructure — all working.
Dubai prices rise 7–11% a year. You get both rental yield 6–9% and capital appreciation. Total return 14–20% per year in dollars.

risks.intro: Rentals are a business. We talk about real risks and show the protection mechanisms we apply for every client.

items.m: Our PM partner guarantees 85%+ average occupancy or refunds part of the fee.
The DLD Rental Index is public — we track the market and switch strategy.
5% reserve fund from monthly rent for repairs. Fixed-price contractor rates.

items.q: How much does the property manager cost?
items.a: Long-term: 5–8% of collected rent. Short-term: 18–22% (including cleaning, linen, listings on 8+ platforms, guest communication).

items.q: Can I buy without coming to Dubai?
items.a: Yes. A remote deal via power of attorney is handled in 7 days. Online tours, video link during the DLD transfer.

items.q: How do I receive the money — to a home bank account?
items.a: We open a UAE account for you (Emirates NBD, Mashreq) at purchase. Rent arrives in dirhams, easily converted to USD/EUR/RUB.

items.q: What if the apartment sits empty?
items.a: Our PM partner guarantees 85%+ occupancy or covers the gap from their fee. For long-term: vacant periods are covered by the current tenant's deposit.
From $150K (studio in JVC) — 8–9% yield. From $200K — 1BR Business Bay. From $500K — Marina/Downtown short-term with premium income.

items.q: Who pays taxes, insurance, service charge?
items.a: The service charge is paid by the owner (5–25 AED/sqft per year). It's already included in our yield calculations. The UAE has no income tax.
